scope: Theorem 6.12 (Algebraic dichotomy) of the manuscript “Entropy equality and local symmetry in negative curvature” (preprints/Entropy-equality-and-local-symmetry-in-negative-curvature-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 339 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8658ab8209a8aa0c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: At typical centers exactly one of the following alternatives holds, with the same alternative almost everywhere. (i) The symmetry algebra is finite dimensional. There are h-invariant formal fields with center values Es and Eu, obtained from finite isotypic sign choices. Their full ambient jets are smooth and holonomic along both entire typical axes and equivariant under the dynamics. (ii) The symmetry algebra is infinite dimensional. The intrinsic proper open subalgebra l ⊃ k determines an involutive coisotropic formal distribution L, whose characteristic distribution is P = Lω. It contains an intrinsic nonzero plane P′ with nonzero actual stable and unstable parts Ps, Pu. These parts are invariant under the full u action transferred from B∗, and all these formal fields have the same whole-axis coherence and equivariance.
